name: dogfood-anthropic-chatbot
description: Dogfood app 1 (v1.12-2) — an Anthropic Messages API chatbot that exercises streaming, system prompt, tool_use and cost tracking, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls @anthropic-ai/sdk when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa/ai-llm createAnthropicMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/ai-llm -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
